content: Kavya Iyer calls insurance agent Karan Joshi to confirm if her new policy is active. Karan informs her that the policy is still being processed and will be active by the end of the day. He also confirms that her old policy expired today and that she will receive policy details via email by tonight or tomorrow morning.

action_items: Customer's new policy to be processed and activated by the end of the day
Customer to receive an email with policy details by tonight or tomorrow morning
